slides.title: Self-assessment
list: ☐ My vowel length contrasts are clear (*ship / sheep*).
☐ I don't add vowels to clusters (*school*, not *eschool*).
☐ I put main stress on the key word of each idea.
☐ I am understood by speakers of other languages.

items.s: A native-like accent is necessary at C2.
Word and sentence stress strongly affect intelligibility.
